narrative.overview:
DECA Masters looks like the board at a competition: a deep navy stage, one electric edge light, refined white type, and event codes as the primary keys of everything. The signed-out landing is the stage itself (navy in both colour schemes) with a faceted metal structure of six cluster sectors, lit from inside through its seams; the app pages follow the visitor's scheme in a refined white with navy-black ink, and the navy top bar and footer frame both.

Density is a program, not a dashboard: ruled rows, fixed columns that never move, mono for codes, timers and counts, and plain sentence-case words for everything else. Motion is one authored moment (the hero's assembly and headline) plus small state answers to what the visitor does. The system refuses the gradient hero with a device mock-up and a row of three cards, glass as decoration, and anything that implies DECA Inc. made it (no DECA diamond logo, ever).
keyCharacteristics: Navy stage (#071634 to #040a18) with a single electric accent; never a second accent hue.
Corners from 2px (controls) to 6px (the ceiling); nothing rounder.
The 45 degree facet square is the repeated unit: list marker, progress tick, cluster key, journey stop.
Mono only for measured things: event codes, timers, scores, counts, routes.
Illustrative numbers always carry an "Illustrative values" tag; empty data says so in words.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Electric is the only light source. It marks the selected, the focused and the live; it never fills large areas and never becomes a gradient behind text.

rules.name: The Cluster Key Rule
rules.body: DECA's cluster colours (finance #009b46, marketing #cc1d36, business management #f7bc00, entrepreneurship #7c8689, hospitality #0b74bf, personal finance #91c659) appear only as small facet markers, never as fills behind text.

rules.name: The Measured Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono is for measured things only. Words such as "Solo", "Pairs" or "Every event" stay in the body face, even in a table of numbers.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small label above a heading. The heading carries itself; supporting facts go after it.

rules.name: The No Ghost Card Rule
rules.body: A hairline border is the card's elevation. A card with a border gets no soft shadow under it.

dos: Do keep the landing navy in both colour schemes and the working pages in the visitor's scheme.
Do compute every count, time and format fact from the published content; show "None", "n of m" or an honest empty state when the data is missing.
Do tag made-up numbers "Illustrative values" on the window that shows them.
Do keep 3D behind Mount3D: lazy chunk, device tier, poster first, paused off screen.
donts: Don't use the DECA diamond logo or anything that implies DECA Inc. made or endorses the site.
Don't round anything past 6px, add glass outside panels floating on the 3D canvas, or add a second accent hue.
Don't put a coloured border-left on a list item or card to show selection; use an outline or a fill.
Don't use mono for words, or a small label above a heading.
Don't fade the first viewport's largest text in from transparent; it holds back the page's largest paint.
